[SWS_CM_10447] Dealing with unmodelled ApApplicationErrors
⌈
If
the service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) returnes an ApApplicationError
different from the modeled ones (i.e., different from the ones referenced by the
ClientServerOperation in role possibleApError or in role possibleApEr-
rorSet.apApplicationError),treating this as a violation according to [SWS_-
CORE_00003]. No message shall be sent back to the client.
⌋
